bioconda.name: logan-walker
bioconda.summary: Reconstruct coding haplotypes from Logan unitig graphs with GraphAligner.
bioconda.description:
Streams an SRA run's Logan unitigs, anchors a reference coding sequence with shared k-mers,
extracts the local de Bruijn subgraph, aligns the reference to it with GraphAligner and
walks the best path. Reports one primary haplotype per accession plus intra-host
alternative alleles (FASTA, VCF and a long SNV table). Part of the disassembler suite.
